text:
sam: Heads-up: on prod-sim we're seeing KV cache RSS creep with long-context workloads (~100k tokens). Fragmentation measured ~28% vs expected ~6%. Free blocks are highly scattered across slabs, reuse rate falling over time.

maya: Hmm. Any recent allocator/kernel changes? can you drop the pmap/profile?

sam: quick snapshot from perf run: `slab-alloc: 48MB, holes: 13MB, avg-free-run: 512B, reuse-hit: 62%`. Observed steady RSS climb over 30m with sequential long requests.

ryan: Two quick ideas: (1) opportunistic defrag during idle GPU cycles; (2) compact-on-allocate for large allocations (threshold e.g., >8KB). Both minimize full-stop GC.

olivia: +1 on opportunistic but caution: compaction can spike CPU and hurt p99. we need hard bounds on pause times (<2ms target).

lee: Another angle: block size tuning. moving slab block size from 4KB->8KB reduced internal fragmentation in my microbench because typical KV chunks were 6-7KB after metadata. also consider a hybrid buddy+slab allocator to merge adjacent frees.

sam: Prototype update: implemented merge-on-free and a background defragger that runs when active_streams==0 and cpu_util<20%. In staging sim it dropped fragmentation from 28%->8% after ~12min.

maya: Nice. What about worst-case copy bandwidth and latency impact?

sam: worst-case copy per pass ~3.2MB (we shuffle contiguous ranges), defrag pass rate currently 10MB/s (throttled). measured tail pause spikes ~8-12ms in naive mode, but rate-limited defrag keeps p99 under 2ms most of the time.

perf-bot: alloc-trace summary: alloc-rate=12k/s, free-rate=9k/s, peak-holes=17MB, reuse-hit-time-window=45s -> indicates inter-request reuse but gradual scatter.

ryan: We should also add a placement hint API from the model server: tag KV entries with reuse-likelihood so allocator prefers co-locating high-reuse keys to reduce fragmentation over time. low-effort: a hint bit in the alloc path.

olivia: That could help, but it's additional churn to model side. For short-term let's prioritize server-side heuristics. Need A/B plan: metric set = p50/p95/p99 latency, kv.fragmentation_pct, kv.defrag_bytes, kv.defrag_pause_ms, and memory RSS.

lee: Also propose a dynamic block-size experiment: per-slab-size histograms and adaptive block sizing per model type. If model's kvavg>6KB, allocate from 8KB slab class. keep 4KB for small entries.

maya: I'll run a soak test on staging with defrag-v1 (rate-limited to 10MB/s, only run when cpu<20% and no active streams) for 48h and collect metrics.

sam: PR is up: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 (proto branch defrag-v1). It includes metrics: `kv.fragmentation_pct`, `kv.defrag_bytes_total`, `kv.defrag_pause_ms`. cc @maya @lee @ryan.

maya: Running now. If it looks good in 24h I'll flip canary to 5%.

olivia: Add safety: fallback to LRU eviction if defrag backlog > 100MB or if pause_ms > 5ms for two consecutive windows. No silent mem-growth.

sam: Good call. I added an emergency-evict path in the PR.

lee: Add instrument: histogram of contiguous-free-run lengths so we can tune merge thresholds.

perf-bot: nightly perf job scheduled. will post updated flame + alloc-trace after 24h soak.

sam: Thanks all. If staging soak looks clean we'll ship to canary next week. :thumbsup:
